Veterans Day always makes me think of my husband. I’m proud of him for so many reasons, and his service is one of them.

Today I’m also thinking of the veterans we’ve been lucky enough to get to know through mahjong. I’m grateful our paths crossed over a game we love, and I’m glad we get to take a moment today to honor this part of your lives.

To all who have served, thank you. We’re thinking of you and your families today. ❤️

— Brittany, Mac + Miller Mahjong
